title: [Mai][German Localization] Recurring Frequency DateFormula Exports as Invariant Tokens (+1D/+1Y) Instead of Localized UI Tokens (+1T/+1J) in ExcelInital commit
summary: The Recurring General Journal page now exports recurring frequency date formulas in localized UI tokens (like +1T for German) instead of invariant tokens (+1D) when exporting to Excel or OData.
key_points: Page field binding changed from direct table field to text variable using Format() for localized display
On validation, entered text is evaluated and converted back to DateFormula for storage
Fixes German and other localization exports to show localized date formula tokens
Applied across multiple language layers (W1, APAC, ES, IT, RU)
Includes test coverage for the conversion logic
